query.sql:
-- metric roas v2
SELECT
  channel,
  SUM(revenue) AS numerator,
  SUM(ad_spend) AS denominator,
  SUM(revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(ad_spend), 0) AS value
FROM daily_channel_device
WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-25' AND DATE '2026-10-22'
  AND channel IN ('google_ads', 'meta_ads', 'tiktok_ads')
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY value DESC

description.en: Back-office revenue from orders whose last non-direct click came from the channel, divided by that channel’s spend. Platform-reported conversions are not used.
description.tr: Son doğrudan olmayan tıklaması kanaldan gelen siparişlerin arka ofis cirosu, bölü o kanalın harcaması. Platformların bildirdiği dönüşümler kullanılmaz.
